The three curves are labeled I, II, III respectively: curves I and II both start from close to 0, increase with time, and tend toward a plateau; curve III starts from a higher concentration, decreases with time, and tends toward a plateau. Reasoning: At the beginning, the container has only NO2, so the curve that is consumed as the reaction proceeds and whose concentration decreases should be NO2, corresponding to curve III. To find the instantaneous rate of disappearance of NO2 at t = 30 s, one should draw a tangent at the point t = 30 s on curve III, and then use two convenient points on that tangent to find the slope. Because curve III represents [NO2] decreasing with time, the slope of the tangent is d[NO2]/dt and is negative; the rate of disappearance of NO2 takes its opposite number or magnitude, namely -d[NO2]/dt.

raw_record.question_text:
$NO_2$ gas is placed in a sealed, evacuated container and allowed to decompose via the following equation:
$2NO_2(g) \leftrightarrow 2NO(g) + O_2(g)$
The graph below indicates the change in concentration for each species over time. Using the graph, how can the instantaneous rate of disappearance of $NO_2$ at $t = 30$ s be determined?
raw_record.standard_answer: By taking the slope of a line tangent to the $NO_2$ curve at $t = 30$ s

method.method_draft: First describe the graph: concentration is plotted versus time, with curve III decreasing while curves I and II increase. Since the container initially contains only NO2, identify the decreasing curve III as NO2. At t = 30 s, draw a line tangent to curve III and determine its slope from two convenient points on that tangent. The instantaneous rate of disappearance of NO2 is the magnitude of this tangent slope, -d[NO2]/dt, at 30 s.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中纵轴是浓度（M），横轴是时间（s），横轴标出约 30、60、90 s。三条曲线分别标为 I、II、III：曲线 I 和 II 都从接近 0 开始随时间增加并趋于平台；曲线 III 从较高浓度开始随时间下降并趋于平台。

推理：容器开始时只有 NO2，因此随反应进行而被消耗、浓度下降的曲线应是 NO2，对应曲线 III。要在 t = 30 s 求 NO2 的瞬时消失速率，应在曲线 III 上 t = 30 s 的点作切线，再用该切线上两个方便的点求斜率。因为曲线 III 表示 [NO2] 随时间下降，切线斜率是 d[NO2]/dt，为负；NO2 的消失速率取其相反数或大小，即 -d[NO2]/dt。
method.model_answer: 在 t = 30 s 处对 NO2 的曲线（图中的下降曲线 III）作切线，并求该切线的斜率；NO2 的瞬时消失速率就是该斜率的大小，即 -d[NO2]/dt。

method.method_draft: First describe the graph: curve III decreases from an initial concentration, while curves I and II rise from zero; curve I rises more than curve II. Use the balanced equation to identify curve I as NO and curve II as O2. At t = 30 s, draw a tangent to curve I and take its slope; that slope equals the instantaneous disappearance rate of NO2. Equivalently, draw a tangent to curve II at 30 s and double its slope to get the disappearance rate of NO2.
method.CoT_raw: Image description: The graph plots concentration versus time. Curve III starts at a high concentration and decreases, then levels off. Curves I and II start at zero and increase, then level off; curve I reaches a higher final concentration than curve II. Reasoning: Since the container initially contains only NO2, the decreasing curve III represents NO2. From the balanced equation 2NO2(g) ⇌ 2NO(g) + O2(g), NO is produced twice as much as O2, so curve I is NO and curve II is O2. At t = 30 s, the instantaneous rate is found from the slope of a tangent line at that time. The rate of disappearance of NO2 can therefore be obtained as the negative of the slope of the tangent to curve III at t = 30 s. Equivalently, because NO and NO2 have equal stoichiometric coefficients, it can be found from the slope of the tangent to curve I at 30 s; or by taking twice the slope of the tangent to curve II at 30 s.
method.model_answer: Draw a tangent line to the NO2 curve, curve III, at t = 30 s and take the negative of its slope. Equivalently, take the slope of the tangent to the NO curve, curve I, at 30 s, or twice the slope of the tangent to the O2 curve, curve II.
